set.body:
Add ASC materialized admission to the PM3.2 collector and reuse the EyeLink generator/performance court for bounded streaming. Preserve typed import diagnostics, full emitted rows and parser chunk policies; compare the same emitted sample fields. Include high-rate binocular/gap input and input-length scaling. Do not equate peak process RSS with the old heap-delta counter.

Bounded adapter slice using docs/plans/PYMOVEMENTS_PERFORMANCE.md and the PM3.2 collector. Acceptance: source/data/config-bound raw receipts for all declared scales and modes; deliberate wrong-output and failed-process cases rejected; no budget relaxation after results. Run relevant correctness checks. Split before implementation if more than roughly half a day. This adapter alone cannot close PM3.
set.title: PM3.4 Measure paired ASC admission and the existing streaming court
